# Dify Training Lab — agent brief
# Canonical human handoff index: HANDOFFs.md
# Long-form continuity: docs/HANDOFF.md
# Project memory & non-negotiables: AGENTS.md
# Docs index: docs/README.md

## Purpose

Enterprise training lab replacing n8n with self-hosted Dify CE 1.17.1 for the 2-day course
"No-Code Agentic AI: Building Business Automation" (health-insurance scenarios).
Builders use Dify Studio; students use portal BFF → Dify Service API (user=portal_student_id).
Optional Open WebUI (:3848) is demo-only, not the class path.

## Non-negotiables

- n8n is unapproved — do not reintroduce.
- Minimize student logins; portal is the only student IdP.
- LLM keys only from operator (.env / portal secrets); never commit secrets.
- Pinned Dify 1.17.1 under vendor/dify/docker (vendor/DIFY_VERSION).
- Lab ports: Dify 3847, Open WebUI 3848, mock claims 3860.
- Browser: use localhost (not 127.0.0.1) for Studio auth cookies.

## Key paths

AGENTS.md              — durable project memory, ops commands
HANDOFFs.md            — colleague-facing index (status, run, GitHub)
docs/HANDOFF.md        — detailed handoff (tenancy, screenshots, teardown)
docs/PUBLIC_REPO.md    — GitHub + Origin mirror vs dual remotes
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md   — topology, compose, scale
docs/README.md         — documentation hierarchy
templates/lab-catalog.yaml — 30 catalog labs
lab/                   — compose overlays, tests, instances
scripts/               — up.sh, status.sh, programme-gate.sh, sync-github.sh
web/                   — Vercel walkthrough (collab demo; not student path)
tools/vibium/          — screenshot capture for lab materials
vendor/dify/docker/    — pinned Dify compose tree

## Active programme (compound build)

Tracker: docs/operations/LAB-FACTORY-CHECKLIST.md
SOP: docs/operations/COMPOUND-BUILD-SOP.md
Skill: skills/compound-build-loop/SKILL.md

Status (checklist):
  S0 framework + catalog + mock claims — done (eval SHIP)
  S1 M1–M3 core runbooks — done (eval SHIP)
  S2 DSL exports M2–M4 core — pending
  S3 portal wire contract — pending
  S4 stretch tier instance — pending
  S5 bundle doc sync — pending
  Integration PR — hold until S0–S5 SHIP + programme gate green

Rules: implementers must not self-SHIP; one integrator runs OPENROUTER_LIVE=1
when slice eval requires live OpenRouter (no parallel live calls).

## Gates

./scripts/programme-gate.sh
  → lab-light-test.sh (mock claims :3860, catalog checks)
  → web npm run lint
  → optional OPENROUTER_LIVE=1 integrator ping

Slice defaults (unless build spec says docs-only):
  ./scripts/lab-light-test.sh
  cd web && npm run lint

Pre-bundle: programme-gate on integration branch tip (see COMPOUND-BUILD-SOP).

## Runbooks & catalog & framework

Catalog: templates/lab-catalog.yaml
Runbooks: docs/lab-materials/ (module runbooks per S1 spec)
Framework: lab/ instances, lab-wire.sh, mock claims under lab/
Build log: docs/operations/build-log/
Evaluations: docs/operations/evaluations/

## Ops (operator)

cp .env.example .env   # OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
./scripts/ensure-docker.sh
./scripts/up.sh
./scripts/status.sh

LAB_MODE: dify (default) | full (Dify + WebUI) | webui

## GitHub handoff

Origin (private SoT today for named repo): manutej/dify-labs on Origin; mirrorStatus no-mirror.
Public GitHub repo not auto-created by agents without gh auth / GITHUB_TOKEN.
Dual-remote push: ./scripts/sync-github.sh (after git remote add github …).
Details: docs/PUBLIC_REPO.md, HANDOFFs.md § GitHub sharing.

## Walkthrough / teardown note

Public walkthrough: dify-labs-walkthrough.vercel.app — demo-only, shared password, BYO OpenRouter key.
Teardown target ~2026-10-06: remove Vercel secrets, stop tunnel :3847 / SSO :3850, restore localhost URLs.
See docs/HANDOFF.md collaborator section.
